check: cross-confirm the no-enable-path finding against the project's own documentation
why: Concluding from code alone that a feature cannot be enabled risks missing a documented route, so the documents were searched for any instruction on setting greatwall.production.
result: The documentation agrees with the code rather than contradicting it.

citations.meaning: formal production=true is explicitly refused; the isolated fixture needs productionFixture=true plus two disk markers, and is mutually exclusive with the S0 probe
the isolated fixture may be enabled; formal production=true is still refused at the production entry
production wiring stays OFF until final acceptance
the summary states GreatWall production remains OFF

noDocumentedRoute: No document gives a procedure for setting greatwall.production to true as a user action. It appears only as something that is refused.
conclusion: Code and documents say the same thing in different words, so this is not a reading error on my part. Installing the jar cannot produce a wall, and that is the intended state rather than a defect.
